reviews.title: Tradewinds Aviation is AWESOME!
reviews.text: We have flown to St Barth on a few occasions and have used two different plane services. Tradewind by far is the most exceptional experience we have had!! We payed for concierge service and it was worth every penny! We were met at the arrival gate and guided to a nicely stocked lounge while our luggage was gathered and passports checked. The employees were amazing! The flight was smooth and the plane clean and cool. Departure was also smooth. Upon arrival back at San Juan, we were escorted to TSA by a very knowledgeable and friendly employee. Without him, we would have NEVER made our flight as that airport is a nightmare! We will always use Tradewind Aviation when available!
reviews.author: Sean M

reviews.title: Very Professional
reviews.text: Another highly professional experience with Tradewind. We arrived ahead of schedule in SBH, and the pilots were first class as usual.
reviews.author: fatbear2000

reviews.title: Another Excellent Flight
reviews.text: We recently flew again with Tradewind Aviation between Antigua and St Barths, and back again. From Antigua we flew in their Pilatus which is marketed as Sexy Jet, and is configured for executive travel with only 6 seats rather than the usual 8 seats, and there was a small bottle of champagne amongst the drinks in the ice box. I am not sure what their marketing people would have been thinking if they saw a fatbear getting on and off it ! The flight from St Barths was full with 7 passengers and one extremely well behaved dog. As everyone was ready, we departed 30 minutes early, although the downside of this was that it gave us an extra 30 minutes to wait for our connection in Antigua ! As always, the Tradewind pilots were extremely pleasant.
reviews.author: fatbear2000

reviews.title: Start your vacation early
reviews.text: Flew from San Juan to St Bart's Christmas day. What a pleasure compared to flying through St Martin. Easy to navigate the terminal to the Tradewind lounge, super friendly staff, swiss train-like departure and arrival. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Planningmynextmeal

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: Wow! After a disaster with Win Air I had to rebook a flight with Tradewind last minute out of St. Bart’s. Tradewind was quick to respond to all of my emails and inquiries. Their website was easy, modern and very nice to use. Luckily I was able to book as a codeshare with United and got a single itinerary home. All workers I met in both St. Bart’s and San Juan airport were exceptional. Because everyone in our flight was present, we left thirty minutes early and reached SJU much earlier than anticipated. The plane (jet?) was sleek, comfortable and clean. Snacks and Evian water were provided which was a very nice touch. Pilots were friendly and answered all of our questions. While airfare is pricey, I would highly recommend Tradewind and would absolutely use them again to St. Bart’s or another location they fly (and would be willing to pay more to do so).
reviews.author: IcedMacchiato

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Fast & Efficient PC12 for a Comfortable 45 Min leg to San Juan. Highly Recomanded, Hassle Free Immigration in San Juan. Cheers and Thanks to Pilots and Staff.
reviews.author: Mister BR

reviews.title: A Welcome Alternative to WinAir to St. Barth
reviews.text: WinAir delivered appalling service from St. Maarten in our last trip to SBH. They left at least 6 passengers at the gate in SXM when the plane took off 20 minutes early. Unforgiveable! We knew Tradewinds was an alternative and chose to use their service thru San Juan. We're very happy with the choice. We were guided to Tradewind's small departure lounge where we enjoyed drinks and snacks in comfort while waiting for departure. We went through a separate and extremely easy security check before boarding the plane. The plane holds only eight passengers so conditions are cramped but it's comfortable clean and new. The flight lasts about an hour. Tradewind will depart early if all passengers are present -- this is more frequent from SBH -- a nice little help for connections. Tradewind is a scheduled airline, but this service feels more like a charter. It is priced higher as a result. But it's worth is for great friendly service and comfort.
reviews.author: Paul N

reviews.title: bad!
reviews.text: So far bad experience. 14 hours delay with the flight of tradewind. Of course all the connecting flights after that are missed. In the airport for 6 hours now still no solution from the company on our following flights. 2 days of vacation in an airport? why not.... sponsored by Tradewind. Merci!
reviews.author: Alexandra

reviews.title: Excellent !
reviews.text: We continue to fly with Tradewind to get to/from St Barths from Antigua. Great service and lovely aircraft !
reviews.author: fatbear2000

reviews.title: Outstanding Service
reviews.text: If you desire on-time performance, outstanding service and great views to St. Barths, Tradewind is your ticket. It’s our third year flying this route and each trip has been flawless.
reviews.author: Alisha W

reviews.title: Great Charter From San Juan to St. Barts
reviews.text: We go from Atlanta to St Bart’s every year. Our best routing is through San Juan instead of St Marteen. You have to take two flights no matter what because of the tiny runway at St Bart’s. San Juan is better because no customs and immigration clearing being a US territory. The carrier, Tradewinds will do a VIP meet and greet at the arriving commercial flight, hand transfer your bags and put you in a private lounge while you wait. They have many scheduled flights exclusively on a Pilates PC-12. Second leg is about an hour. If you hav 6-8 in your group it’s best to just arrange a private charter on the same plane with them. They are based in the northeast and do Nantucket and Cape Cod shuttles as well. Also serve Antigua, Anguilla and other islands from San Juan.
reviews.author: John S

reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: We had limited choices to get to St. Barths, and we were very happy with our experience with Tradewind Aviation. Check-in at both the San Juan and St. Barths airports was smooth and painless, with no wait time and the staff was very courteous in each location. The lounge area in San Juan was nice and well appointed. The pilots were very professional and each flight was uneventful (the way I like my flights). We highly recommend Tradewind, and will use them in the future.
reviews.author: RVonthegoandgo

reviews.title: Great service as always
reviews.text: Had to book a flight to the FRENCH ISLANDS, and my only option was Tradewinds via SBH. CAn't complaint, their service is always outstanding and the staff is always in top of every detail, their pilots extremely friendly and courteous. This is not my first time with them, I even coincide with their prsident in a flight to SBH once, very attntive person and down to earth. Of course a good business man.
reviews.author: William G

reviews.title: Above and beyond!!
reviews.text: First off...was only given "economy" as a choice on "class of service" and full disclosure, this was actually a shared charter. The flight left just a bit after we were supposed to because of a delay coming in from another island. My wife and I had a very tight connection going through San Juan and even as "trusted travelers" going through customs, it would have been difficult to make our flight. The pilot stayed with us through customs, through ag inspection, and right up to check in. Even helped with our luggage. I am so sorry I didn't get his name. We can't imagine taking a different carrier to St Barth and over the years have tried many. Well worth the bump in price in a world where time is money not to mention the convenience of going through Puerto Rico vs St Martin.
reviews.author: craigdianek

reviews.title: THE way to travel
reviews.text: This is definitely the best way to get from the US to St. Barth. The plane is usually a 12 seater. The airline has its own private waiting area in the San Juan airport. You have a personal escort to the plane. Once you get on the plane, it's about an hour flight. Sit back and relax. They really do take great care of you.
reviews.author: Pamela H

reviews.title: Easy Way to Get to St. Barth's
reviews.text: The Tradewinds flight from San Juan to St. Barth's is easy and comfortable. The staff and pilots were friendly and helpful when going through customs on our return flight to San Juan from St. Barth's. This is the easiest way to get to St. Barth's while the St. Martin airport is rebuilt. The cost of the flight is pricey.
reviews.author: nqh1223

reviews.title: Friendly in the skies and on the ground
reviews.text: This is how an airlines SHOULD BE! The flight crews both getting to and from Gustavia, St Barthelemy couldn't have been nicer. They were friendly and helpful. They truly took care of us, even going so far as to recommend sites to see and visit. On our way home our pilots and one of the people at the airport were extremely friendly, walking with us through the maze of the airport and the gentleman at the airport walked us to the lounge for travelers who have a long layover. These people were absolutely wonderful! We can't say enough good things about them. We can't wait to see them again next year!
reviews.author: Katherine F

reviews.title: The best flying experience in my life
reviews.text: Tradewind is the number one company to come to st Barth via Porto Rico The service is great The plane is beautiful like a private jet You have to try They give you a nice little snack chips and drinks Very very nice people
reviews.author: Olivier Genet

reviews.title: Great People
reviews.text: We flew United from Chicago to Antigua with a connection in Newark, NJ. Our return flight to Newark was cancelled due to weather. United rebooked us using Tradewind on Friday to St. Barts with a overnight stay. On Saturday, Tradewind was to take us on to San Juan Puerto Rico and then finally United back to Chicago. Doing some research I found the flight to St. Barts was actually continuing on to San Juan on Friday. I called United and asked if we could just stay on the plane and overnight in San Juan. United said NO. Upon checking in for our flight to St. Barts, I asked Tradewind if we could continue on to San Juan on Friday and they said yes. Upon landing in San Juan, we were concerned about getting a hotel on such short notice. It was 7pm and we had no place to stay. A Tradewind representative by the name of Carlos met us at the plane and helped us navigate getting our bags and customs. He then stayed with us and allowed us to use the Tradewind lounge while we were trying to find a hotel. I wish more airlines had caring people like Carlos. Thanks to Carlos and Tradewinds for making our bad travel better!
reviews.author: G P

reviews.title: Hurricane Irma
reviews.text: Hello, I was in Saint Barth when it has been touched by the hurricane Irma and had the chance to be evacuated thanks to Tradewind Aviation. I would like to thank them for what they did and Laetitia Decreuse for her help, I could not have been evacuated without both of them. Thank you
reviews.author: JcGilbert1997

reviews.title: wonderful way to reach St Barts
reviews.text: The PERFECT way to avoid St Martin airport and arrive onto St Barts in style. Also have a passenger lounge in San Juan making this flight even nicer. Reaching San Juan is often easier than St Martin so another plus. The price is off set by the flight to reach SJU. The small plane has a "self serve" cabin steward cooler down the aisle with wine, beer and soft drinks. Arriving on SBH you have a teriffic view as all are window seats.
reviews.author: Michael C

reviews.title: Great little airline!
reviews.text: Everyone at Tradewind makes flying with them an absolute pleasure. Although Tripadvisor makes you pick a class of service and the only option available is economy...the level of service is first class! There are only 8 seats or less on the aircraft depending on configuration. Great flights!!
reviews.author: craigdianek

reviews.title: Superb
reviews.text: We have just had another fabulous experience flying with Tradewind. We arrived in Antigua to connect to our scheduled flight to St Barths and were met by Dave, the local agent, who in his cheerful manner did his best to steer us through the bureaucracy that is Antigua Airport. Although our flight was due to depart at 16.50, as we had arrived in Antigua three hours earlier, the aircraft was sent early and we were able to depart at 15.50. Therefore, full marks to Tradewind for getting us to St Barths an hour early ! The two pilots were very friendly and the Pilatus is a fabulous aircraft to fly in. We also took advantage of the refreshments in the cooler box on board, helping ourselves to a small bottle of white wine and a bottle of water. All landings at St Barths are spectacular, this time we landed over the hill but only needed about half of the runway. We have already booked our next flight to St Barths on Tradewind.
reviews.author: fatbear2000

reviews.title: St. Barths
reviews.text: We usually route through St. Maarten and use Winair to get to St. Barths but decided to try Tradewind for the route home. Great improvement. San Juan is a much more organized airport than St. Maarten. Staff of Tradewind were attentive and friendly and the plane was air conditioned and very stable for the size. I very much enjoyed San Juan as well generally so will change our future routing.
reviews.author: archiscot

reviews.title: Caution passengers
reviews.text: Round trip private charter. Flight crews very professional and equipment satisfactory. Ground crew in San Juan rude, careless, unprofessional, argumentative and unprofessional. Luggage was mishandled, not tagged and haphazardly put on other flights. There were bags missing and multiple employees yelled at us and insisted that we had all of our bags. They refused to call a supervisor. They tried to intimidate us to leave baggage claim without our luggage. We refused and ultimately our pilot intervened and found our missing luggage on a lower level. The bag was later found to be rummaged through and a gift item was missing from the bag. If you must use this airline, lock your bags and personally insure that each of your bags has been tagged and you receive receipts that match ID numbers in order to avoid this crafty scam.
reviews.author: Imperious

reviews.title: Tradewind to Nevis
reviews.text: Outstanding flights both going and return. Very professional service and pilots. This is THE way to travel to Nevis. Pack light - small luggage is best - you need only a few light things in Nevis anyway. Just FYI: 20.50 USD per person departure fees collected at Nevis airport
reviews.author: Wandering Fly Fisher

reviews.title: The Best Inter Island Carrier
reviews.text: Great service, good aircraft, nice flight. Ticketing and boarding was efficient. The crew was friendly and yet brief. The aircraft was clean and cool (temperature wise, which is not the case on most inter island carriers). Perfect for scheduled and charter flights.
reviews.author: KLantz2014

reviews.title: Fantastic customer service
reviews.text: After having our flight cancelled on American Airlines we went to Jet Blue and were able to get a flight to San Juan PR the Nisbet Plantation Beach Hotel made reservations for us directly to Nevis when we arrived at the airport a representative was there to greet us when we deplaned asked us to describe our luggage and took care of retrieving our bags and checking them in for our flight and escorted us to a very nice lounge to relax have drinks and snacks while we waited for our departure can't say enough about this airline made our trip a success
reviews.author: drboutiquetravel

reviews.title: I LOVE TRADEWIND AVIATION!
reviews.text: This is such a great way of travelling. Such a shame it is such a short flight, I could have circled in the plane for hours. The Pilot and Co-Pilot on both my flights were so friendly and accommodating. I even had the plane to myself on the way back. The plane is small but VERY comfortable... As it is a small plane the check-in and ground service is VERY personal. They really made me feel like I had chartered my own plane. On the way back I had a very long layover. The ground staff found me a taxi driver who took me to a lovely beach restaurant where I could relax for five hours before coming back to collect me.
reviews.author: Ricky T

reviews.title: Definitely fly Tradewind
reviews.text: We had a disturbing 24 HR nightmare with Liat but Michelle Suarez at the Tradewind counter was superb! She helped us figure out a way to St Marteen where we have a conference! She was kind, friendly and very very helpful ! Got a ride to St Barth! Their lounge is comfy , has snacks, peolple are smiling , everyone is so service oriented! The flight was smooth! Even snacks for the flight! You guys saved our sanity! Thank you so much!!!
reviews.author: Tereteres

reviews.title: Best way to get to St. Barts
reviews.text: This airline is absolutely wonderful. The plane is very nice, the staff is amazing, and the flight is a breeze. AA lost our luggage going to San Juan and Tradewind coordinated everything (2 days later when AA finally got our luggage to San Juan) and got us our luggage in St. Barths with no issues, and with a great attitude. They've forever earned my business after only one experience with them.
reviews.author: TXWMc

reviews.title: As good as it gets!
reviews.text: My wife and I use Tradewind Aviation when ever possible while flying in the Caribbean. As a former aircraft owner and pilot, this operation is like having your own plane and crew without the cost & expense thereof. Their PC-12's & CJ3's are well maintained and spotless - their flight & ground crews are friendly and efficient. They have a nice private waiting area at their hub in SJU and they make every effort to ensure your comfort, safety and to get ALL your luggage to your final destination. FIVE STARS PLUS
reviews.author: DownIsland

reviews.title: I felt like royalty. Boarding was so easy. Two pilots very friendly. Fabulous views enroute.
reviews.text: This flight seemed like a private charter. Everyone was very helpful and friendly. Almost no wait at the Nevis airport. The seats were very spacious and comfortable.These were the best views I had ever had of the many islands enroute. In San Juan the waiting area was very private and upscale with free water and soft drinks. I was helped going from the arriving Tradewind plane to the lounge and then taken to the next plane. I highly recommend this wonderful experience.
reviews.author: calamityjanetoo

reviews.title: Feels like flying private
reviews.text: I like taking the early morning flights (staying the night on SJU). Fewer people. I get more time on SBH
reviews.author: Virginia B

reviews.title: Lovely Aircraft
reviews.text: Tradewind are a US airline who provide shuttle flights to islands in the Leeward Islands. We recently took return flights to/from St Barths from Antigua and were very impressed. The flights are operated by Pilatus PC-12 aircraft which although only 8 seaters, are very comfortable and fast. The flight from Antigua took less than 25 minutes, and the aircraft look incredibly stylish. I call them Stealth Bombers ! The service on the ground in Antigua is excellent and there was a warm welcome from the 2 pilots on board the Pilatus. Whilst there is no cabin crew on such a small aircraft, Tradewind do provide a cooler box with cold drinks to help yourself too, and there is also a tray of snacks Thoroughly recommended.
reviews.author: fatbear2000
